theme: drop/tmp byte inventory KEEPFILES SIZEALL ZIP THRESHKV TOPKEY

tests.name: scan_star
tests.cmd: PATHGLOB drop * → 5 paths incl nested dir

tests.name: measure_zip
tests.cmd: SIZEALL+BASENAMEALL+ZIP → empty:0 large:20 medium:10 small:5 sum 35

tests.name: measure_with_dirs
tests.cmd: SIZEALL without KEEPFILES → nested:0 miss_n=1 files_n=4

weaknesses.title: SIZEALL maps dirs/missing to 0 — indistinguishable from empty files
weaknesses.detail: Per-field BYTES bag is only decimals; dirs and ghosts become 0 like empty.dat. SIZEALL_MISS/FILES are bag-level meta only — cannot peel which field missed without re-stat.

weaknesses.title: No SIZEALL key:val mode — need BASENAMEALL+ZIP glue
weaknesses.detail: SIZEALL returns parallel size strings; agents must ZIP with BASENAMEALL for name:bytes. Easy to desync if PATHS filtered after measure without remeasure.

weaknesses.title: Parallel PATHS/BYTES desync on post-measure filter
weaknesses.detail: KEEPFILES after measure shortens PATHS but BYTES/SIZES plates stay old until measure again. No atomic paired filter.

weaknesses.title: SKIP KEEPFILES → nested:0 pollutes reclaim SIZES plate
weaknesses.detail: Dir basenames appear as 0-byte reclaim candidates. THRESHKV min>0 drops them but TOPKEY/SUM meta can confuse agents who skip kind filter.

weaknesses.title: ZIP unequal lengths pad empty partner silently
weaknesses.detail: Documented pad; if BYTES shorter, trailing name: empty keys. No hard fail mode for length mismatch.

weaknesses.title: TOPKEY returns key only — value in TOPKEY_V side channel
weaknesses.detail: Agents expecting name:bytes from TOPKEY get basename only; must read TOPKEY_V separately.

workarounds: Always KEEPFILES before SIZEALL for reclaim inventories
Remeasure after any PATHS filter to keep BYTES/SIZES aligned
Use SIZEALL_MISS/FILES as bag-level health not per-field
THRESHKV min>=1 drops zero-byte noise including dir pollution
Print TOPKEY + TOPKEY_V together for agents
language_gaps: Per-field miss/dir markers in SIZEALL output
ZIP strict equal-length mode (fail on mismatch)
issues_faced: Dir/miss as 0 confirmed pollution without KEEPFILES
Empty file vs dir both 0 — only bag meta differs
